# Add a chat restoration test for core initialization after the tab opens

The complete browser_restoreConversations test asserts ChatCore is already initialized before opening the chat tab. It checks the restored conversation UI for that ordering. Recommend a separate controlled late-core case to exercise initAfterChatCore with an existing tab. This is a source-visible coverage gap, not a reproduced missing conversation. These observations are scoped to the cited accepted source and historical changes. Full Bugzilla and historical review timeline/inline discussion remain pending. No Thunderbird runtime, build, lint or live accessibility check was run.

Scope: mail/components/im.
